failures.root_cause: Test passed 'tmp_path' directly to filesystem.list while _execute created 'runtime' inside 'tmp_path', causing 'runtime' to appear in the directory listing unexpectedly.
failures.resolution: Updated test to isolate target directory ('target') from 'tmp_path' so workspace execution artifacts don't pollute the file list.

failures.root_cause: The repository.diff capability unconditionally passed 'head' to git diff, defaulting to 'HEAD'. This prevented git from diffing against the working tree (which requires omitting head).
failures.resolution: Modified runtime/execution/deterministic_executor.py to omit the 'head' argument when diffing against the working tree, allowing 'git diff base'.

failures.root_cause: Mock admin_session in test lacked a 'csrf_token' string property, causing it to return a MagicMock which crashed string replace(). Additionally, the test asserted an outdated dashboard title.
failures.evidence: TypeError: replace() argument 2 must be str, not MagicMock. After fixing type, AssertionError on title.
failures.resolution: Provided explicit csrf_token in mock context and updated the test assertion from 'ANNY Control Plane' to 'ANNY CONTROL CENTER' to match the canonical dashboard.
